description.value:
You have devoted your life to the safety of Cormyr and sought entry into the realm's elite order of warriors, the Purple Dragon Knights. Before you can officially join their ranks, you must serve as a knight's squire. You have found a liege willing to take you on and teach you the order's ways. Will you live up to the Purple Dragon Knights' ideals of glory, honor, and strength and prove yourself worthy of knighthood?

Ability Scores: Strength, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.VETeIoIMUYCh3lq9]{Purple Dragon Rook}

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Insight

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulNavigators]{Navigator's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepSpear00000]{Spear}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulNavigators]{Navigator's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP

QueB22gewCQos3vb.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Strength, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
